描述: 初始化失败(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: 1.PF文件创建或打开失败；2.PF文件解析失败；
应对措施: 重新启动，检查是否恢复正常，否则请联系厂家。

描述: Initialization failed (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: 1. PF file creation or opening failed; 2. PF file parsing failed.
应对措施: Restart controller.

描述: 示教器通讯模块调度失败(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: 1.没有正常启动示教器线程；
应对措施: 重新启动，检查是否恢复正常，否则请联系厂家。

描述: Starting teach pendant communication failed (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: 1. The teach pendant thread was not started properly.
应对措施: Restart controller.

描述: 视觉通讯模块调度失败(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: 1.没有正常启动视觉通讯线程；
应对措施: 重新启动，检查是否恢复正常，否则请联系厂家。

描述: Starting vision communication failed (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: 1. The vision communication thread was not started properly.
应对措施: Restart controller.

描述: 内部通信模块调度失败(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: 1.没有正常启动DSP通讯线程；
应对措施: 重新启动，检查是否恢复正常，否则请联系厂家。

描述: Starting internal communication thread failed (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: 1. The DSP communication thread was not started properly.
应对措施: Restart controller.

描述: 自动、手动功能模块调度失败(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: 1.没有正常启动ARM调度线程；
应对措施: 重新启动，检查是否恢复正常，否则请联系厂家。

描述: Automatic and manual function module scheduling failed (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: 1. The ARM scheduling thread not started properly.
应对措施: Restart controller.

描述: 数据插补模块调度失败(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: 1.没有正常启动插补线程；
应对措施: 重新启动，检查是否恢复正常，否则请联系厂家。

描述: Starting interpolation test failed (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: 1. The interpolation thread not started properly.
应对措施: Restart controller.

描述: EtherCAT通信打开失败(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: 1.配置文件错误；2.EtherCAT从站与系统配置不符
应对措施: 第一步：检查监控页面EtherCAT连接状态是否异常;第二步：请联系厂家

描述: Opening EtherCAT communication failed (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: 1. Configuration file error; 2. EtherCAT slave does not match system configuration.
应对措施: 1: Check if the EtherCAT connection status is abnormal; 2: Contact the manufacturer.

描述: 打开参数配置文件失败
原因: 1.参数配置文件打开失败；2.参数配置文件损坏
应对措施: 系统配置文件错误，请联系厂家

描述: Opening parameter configuration file failed.
原因: 1. Failed to open parameter configuration file; 2. Parameter configuration file was corrupted.
应对措施: Contact the manufacturer.

描述: 译码错误
原因: 程序语法错误
应对措施: 检查程序是否有语法错误，详细错误信息参考输出栏提示信息

描述: Decoding error
原因: Program syntax error
应对措施: Check the program for syntax errors.

描述: 程序行号不合理
原因: 示教器发送的指令行号超出范围
应对措施: 检查示教器蓝色光标所在行是否超出程序范围或者重新选择启动行号

描述: Program line invalid
原因: The program line number sent by the teach pendant is out of range.
应对措施: Check if the line where the blue cursor is located exceeds the program range or reselect the start line number.

描述: Wait指令等待超时
原因: Wait指令等待的时间超出设置时间
应对措施: 1.检查Wait条件；2.重新设置wait指令等待时间

描述: Wait instruction timeout
原因: The wait time exceeds the set range.
应对措施: 1. Check Wait conditions; 2. Reset the wait time.

描述: 读取指令错误
原因: 1.示教文件损坏
应对措施: 1.重新示教文件2.检查示教程序编写规范

描述: Instruction reading error
原因: 1. The teaching program was corrupted; n2. The teaching program does not meet the specifications.
应对措施: 1. Rewrite the teaching program; 2. Check the teaching program.

描述: 子程序不容许嵌套调用
原因: 子程序有嵌套调用
应对措施: 检查Call指令是否嵌套调用子程序

描述: Nested call of subroutine is not allowed.
原因: Nested call of subroutine occurs.
应对措施: Check if the Call instruction is nested to subroutines.

描述: 运动指令译码错误
原因: 运动指令译码错误
应对措施: 检查示教程序

描述: Motion instruction decoding error
原因: Error decoding motion instruction
应对措施: Check the teaching program.

描述: 配置文件操作失败
原因: 1.配置文件保存失败;2.配置文件恢复失败；
应对措施: 1.恢复出厂默认值，并重新上电;2.断电重新启动

描述: Configuration file operation failed.
原因: 1. Configuration file save failed;2. Configuration file restore failed.
应对措施: 1. Restore to the factory defaults and power on again; 2. Power off and restart.

描述: 创建轴插补线程失败
原因: 1.插补线程创建失败；2.内部测试功能没有开放；
应对措施: 1.更换硬件2.更换软件版本

描述: Creating coordinate interpolation thread failed.
原因: 1. Creating coordinate interpolation thread failed; 2. The internal test function is not open.
应对措施: 1. Replace hardware.\ n2. Update software.

描述: jump 指令失败
原因: jump指令中点数据计算错误
应对措施: 重新选取示教点

描述: Jump instruction failed.
原因: Point data calculation error exists in the Jump instruction.
应对措施: Reselect the teaching point.

描述: IRLink 初始化失败(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: 1.IRLink从站个数配置错误2.IRLink从站顺序配置错误；
应对措施: 重新确认IRLink配置

描述: IR Link initialization failed (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: 1. The number of IRLink slaves was configured incorrectly; 2. The sequence of IRLink slaves was configured incorrectly.
应对措施: Confirm the IRLink configuration.

描述: 示教程序保存失败
原因: 存储卡松动或无法识别
应对措施: 检查存储卡

描述: Saving teaching program failed.
原因: The memory card is loose or not recognized.
应对措施: Check the memory card.

描述: 系统内部与运动模块通信错误
原因: DSP软件运行错误
应对措施: 控制器重新上电

描述: Motion module communication error.
原因: DSP software running error
应对措施: Restart the controller.

描述: 内部使能错误
原因: DSP软件运行错误
应对措施: 控制器重新上电

描述: Enable error
原因: DSP software running error
应对措施: Restart the controller.

描述: 系统运动模块程序运行错误
原因: DSP软件运行错误
应对措施: 控制器重新上电

描述: Internal program running error
原因: DSP software running error
应对措施: Restart the controller.

描述: 回零失败
原因: 回零运动失败
应对措施: 重新进行回零

描述: Homing failed.
原因: Homing motion failed.
应对措施: Perform homing again.

描述: 使能缺失
原因: 运行状态丢失使能
应对措施: 检查系统是否使能状态

描述: Enablement lost
原因: The enablement of the running state is lost.
应对措施: Check whether the system is in enabled state.

描述: 检测到伺服参数错误
原因: 设置的参数与实际的伺服参数不匹配
应对措施: 更改使用伺服面板或伺服后台按照出厂参数更改伺服参数。若实际参数和出厂参数不一致，请更换电机或伺服

描述: Servo parameter error detected.
原因: The set parameters do not match the actual servo parameters.
应对措施: Change servo parameters using operating panel or software. If the actual parameters do not match the factory defaults, replace the motor or servo.

描述: 运动状态获取异常
原因: 1.系统内部处理繁忙；2.系统运动固件损坏
应对措施: 1、断电重新启动；2、联系厂家。

描述: Error getting motion state.
原因: 1. System busy; 2. Motion firmware damaged.
应对措施: 1. Restart the controller; 2. Contact the manufacturer.

描述: 配置未成功，PLC配置与实际柜型冲突
原因: PLC配置与实际柜型冲突
应对措施: 检查PLC配置参数与实际柜型是否匹配

描述: The configuration is failed, the PLC configuration is in conflict with the actual cabinet type.
原因: The PLC configuration conflicts with the actual controller model.
应对措施: Check that the PLC configuration parameters match the actual controller model.

描述: 老版本PLC配置，部分功能受影响
原因: 老版本PLC配置
应对措施: 二次开发版本号和机器人二次开发版本号是不匹配，请联系厂家

描述: Some functions are affected because of old version of PLC configuration
原因: Old version PLC configuration
应对措施: The secondary development version number and the robot secondary development version number do not match, please contact the manufacturer.

描述: 伺服规划位置和反馈位置校验错误
原因: arm-dsp通道设置伺服位置时,设置(规划位置)和取回的值(编码器反馈位置)校验不一致
应对措施: 系统故障，请联系厂家

描述: Error verifying planned servo position and feedback position
原因: The planned servo position and the encoder feedback position are inconsistent.
应对措施: System fault, please contact the manufacturer.

描述: 位置同步错误(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: 控制器与伺服位置同步时出错
应对措施: 1、断电重新启动；2、联系厂家。

描述: Position synchronization error (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: Error in synchronizing position between controller and servo.
应对措施: 1. Restart the controller; 2. Contact the manufacturer.

描述: 启动时机器人不允许处于运动状态
原因: 启动时机器人处于运动状态
应对措施: 等待机器人停止后再启动机器人

描述: Robot not allowed to start when in motion.
原因: The robot is moving when started.
应对措施: Restart the robot after it is stopped.

描述: 传入参数错误(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: 传入参数错误
应对措施: 检查系统基本参数设置

描述: Parameter passing in error (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: The parameters passed in are incorrect.
应对措施: Check the basic system settings.

描述: 找不到指令行
原因: 输入行号超出范围
应对措施: 选择运行的指令行

描述: Command line not found.
原因: The line number entered is out of range.
应对措施: Select a command line that is running.

描述: 找不到点数据
原因: 点未定义
应对措施: 检查点是否定义

描述: Point data not found.
原因: The points are not defined.
应对措施: Check if the points are defined.

描述: 数据逆解计算错误
原因: 该点在机器人的奇异点
应对措施: 修改该点的坐标

描述: Inverse kinematics error
原因: The point is a singular point.
应对措施: Modify the coordinates of the point.

描述: 点数据坐标系参数错误
原因: 坐标系值超出范围
应对措施: 重新取点

描述: Point data coordinate error
原因: The coordinate values are out of range.
应对措施: Get the point again.

描述: 直线或圆弧指令臂参数不允许突变
原因: MOVL MOVC JUMPL指令不允许臂参数突变
应对措施: 重新取点或者增加关节过渡点

描述: Armtype in MOVL/MOVC cannot be changed.
原因: Armtype in MOVL/MOVC/JUMPL cannot be changed.
应对措施: Get the point again or add joint transition points.

描述: V参数超出范围
原因: V参数超出范围（1-100）
应对措施: 修改V参数

描述: V parameter out of range
原因: The V parameter is out of range (1-100).
应对措施: Modify the V parameter.

描述: Z参数超出范围
原因: Z参数超出范围（0-5）
应对措施: 修改Z参数

描述: Z parameter out of range
原因: The Z parameter is out of range (0-5).
应对措施: Modify the Z parameter.

描述: TOOL参数超出范围
原因: TOOL参数超出范围(0-15)
应对措施: 修改Tool参数

描述: TOOL parameter out of range
原因: The TOOL parameter is out of range (0-15).
应对措施: Modify the TOOL parameter.

描述: Wobj参数超出范围
原因: Wobj参数超出范围(0-15)
应对措施: 修改User参数

描述: Wobj parameter out of range
原因: The Wobj parameter is out of range (0-15).
应对措施: Modify the User parameter.

描述: ACC 参数超出范围
原因: ACC参数超出范围(1-100)
应对措施: 修改Acc参数

描述: ACC parameter out of range
原因: The ACC parameter is out of range (1-100).
应对措施: Modify the ACC parameter.

描述: until 参数超出范围
原因: IO号超出范围(0-255)
应对措施: 修改Until In参数

描述: until parameter out of range
原因: The I/O number is out of range (0-255).
应对措施: Modify the Until In parameter.

描述: Pallet 参数错误
原因: Pallet（PNo,i,j,k）,PNo,i,j,k大于等于0
应对措施: 修改Pallet参数

描述: Pallet parameter error
原因: PNo,i,j,k in Pallet（PNo,i,j,k) is smaller than 0.
应对措施: Modify the Pallet parameter

描述: 托盘未定义
原因: 托盘序号未定义
应对措施: 托盘定义后使用

描述: Pallet not defined.
原因: The pallet number is not defined.
应对措施: Define the pallet before use.

描述: Repeat 参数错误
原因: Repeat参数超出范围
应对措施: 修改Repeat参数

描述: Repeat parameter error
原因: The Repeat parameter is not defined.
应对措施: Modify the Repeat parameter.

描述: 运行译码错误
原因: 运行过程中指令解析出错
应对措施: 检查运行的指令，根据提示修改

描述: Running decoding error
原因: Error in instruction parsing during running
应对措施: Check the running instructions and modify them according to the prompts.

描述: 基坐标系寸动时数据逆解运算错误
原因: 基坐标系下寸动目标位置超出运行空间或处于奇异区
应对措施: 1.检查寸动步长大小;2.检查寸动方向

描述: Inverse kinematics calculation error in CART
原因: The jog motion destination is out of the motion space or in singularity.
应对措施: 1. Check the step of jog motion; 2. Check the direction of jog motion.

描述: 工具坐标系寸动时数据逆解运算错误
原因: 工具坐标系下寸动目标位置超出运行空间或处于奇异区
应对措施: 1.检查寸动步长大小;2.检查寸动方向

描述: Inverse kinematics calculation error in TOOL
原因: The jog motion destination is out of the motion space or in singularity.
应对措施: 1. Check the step of jog motion; 2. Check the direction of jog motion.

描述: 工件坐标系寸动时数据逆解运算错误
原因: 工件坐标系下寸动目标位置超出运行空间或处于奇异区
应对措施: 1.检查寸动步长大小;2.检查寸动方向

描述: Inverse kinematics calculation error in Wobj
原因: The jog motion destination is out of the motion space or in singularity.
应对措施: 1. Check the step of jog motion; 2. Check the direction of jog motion.

描述: 工具负载参数设置超限
原因: 工具负载参数设置值超出范围
应对措施: 修改工具负载参数

描述: Tool load parameter out of range
原因: The value of Tool load parameter is out of range.
应对措施: Modify the Tool load parameter.

描述: 负载参数设置超限
原因: 负载参数设置值超出范围
应对措施: 修改负载参数

描述: Load parameter out of range
原因: The value of load parameter is out of range.
应对措施: Modify the load parameter.

描述: 臂上负载参数设置超限
原因: 臂上负载参数设置超限
应对措施: 修改臂上负载参数

描述: Arm load parameter out of range
原因: The value of arm load parameter is out of range.
应对措施: Modify the arm load parameter.

描述: 参数设置错误
原因: 参数设置值不在限制范围内
应对措施: 请检查设置的参数范围是否符合要求

描述: Parameter setting error
原因: The parameter setting value is out of range.
应对措施: Check that the set parameter meets the range.

描述: API初始化失败(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: 没有正常启动API通讯线程
应对措施: 1、断电重新启动；

描述: API initialization failed (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: The API communication thread was not started properly.
应对措施: 1. Restart the controller; 2. Contact the manufacturer.

描述: 硬件加密授权失败，系统不可用
原因: 板载硬件加密授权失败
应对措施: 请联系厂商解决

描述: Authentication failure, system is not available.
原因: Fail to authenticate the hardware encryption.
应对措施: Contact the manufacture.

描述: MC模块进程不存在错误
原因: 运动模块进程崩溃，不存在
应对措施: 请刷伺服固件

描述: MC module process does not exist.
原因: The MC module process does not exist.
应对措施: Update the servo firmware.

描述: 机器人系统参数重置，请重启控制器
原因: 机器人系统参数重置（配置文件加载/恢复出厂设置/存储卡格式化/系统升级/系统降级）
应对措施: 控制器重新上电

描述: Robot system parameter reset, please restart the controller.
原因: The robot system parameters are reset (configuration file loading/factory settings restore/memory card formatting/system upgrade/system degrade).
应对措施: Restart the controller.

描述: 软浮动参数初始化异常，需要重启
原因: 软浮动参数初始化异常
应对措施: 需要重启

描述: Exception initializing soft float parameters, please restart the controller.
原因: The soft float parameter initialization is abnormal.
应对措施: Restart the controller.

描述: 初始化平衡杠参数失败
原因: 开机初始化参数平衡杠参数异常
应对措施: 导入正确的平衡杠参数

描述: Failed to initialize balance bar parameters.
原因: Balance bar parameters are abnormal during power-on initialization.
应对措施: Import the correct balance bar parameters.

描述: 触发系统诊断
原因: 触发系统诊断
应对措施: 无需处理，清楚即可

描述: Trigger system diagnostics
原因: Trigger system diagnostics
应对措施: No need to deal with it, just make it clear

描述: 存储卡挂载失败
原因: 存储卡挂载失败
应对措施: 1.断电重启；2.重新插拔存储卡；3.更换存储卡

描述: Failed to mount memory card.
原因: Failed to mount memory card.
应对措施: 1. Restart the controller; 2. Reinstall the memory card; 3. Replace the memory card.

描述: 绑定的端口号与IP地址存在复用
原因: 绑定的端口号或IP地址存在复用
应对措施: 更换端口号或IP地址

描述: Duplicate port or IP address
原因: The bound port or IP address is reused.
应对措施: Change port or IP address.

描述: 以太网通信出错
原因: 以太网通信出错
应对措施: 检查通信线路环境，重新传输数据

描述: Ethernet communication error
原因: Ethernet communication error
应对措施: Check the network connection and retransmit the data.

描述: 网络被干扰
原因: 以太网被多个终端连接
应对措施: 检查是否有多个终端连接同一个控制器

描述: Network is disturbed.
原因: Multiple terminals are connected to one controller.
应对措施: Check if multiple terminals are connected to one controller.

描述: 网络通讯端口打开失败
原因: 网络通讯指令打开错误
应对措施: 检查网络通讯指令

描述: Network communication port opening failed
原因: Network communication open instruction error

原因: 伺服错误获取线程死掉
应对措施: 重新启动机器人

描述: Failed to get thread for servo error.
原因: Failed to get thread for servo error.
应对措施: Restart the robot.

描述: 拧松启动失败
原因: 拆螺丝启动参数发送至伺服端失败
应对措施: 1、检查电批伺服固件是否和控制器匹配2、清零重启

描述: Failed to start loosening.
原因: Failed to send screw removal startup parameters to the servo.
应对措施: 1. Check that the electric screwdriver servo firmware matches with the controller. 2. Clear parameters and restart the system.

描述: 写拧松设置参数失败
原因: 往伺服端写拆螺丝设置参数失败
应对措施: 检查电批伺服固件是否和控制器匹配

描述: Failed to write screw loosening parameters.
原因: Failed to write screw removal setting parameters to the servo.
应对措施: Check that the electric screwdriver servo firmware matches with the controller.

描述: 读拧松设置参数失败
原因: 从伺服端获取拆螺丝设置数据失败
应对措施: 检查电批伺服固件是否和控制器匹配

描述: Failed to read screw loosening parameters.
原因: Failed to obtain screw removal setting data from the servo.
应对措施: Check that the electric screwdriver servo firmware matches with the controller.

描述: 拧松回退点设置超限
原因: 回退点设置超限
应对措施: 将拧松回退点设置在限位范围内

描述: Fallback point setting out of range.
原因: The fallback point is out of range.
应对措施: Set the fallback point for screw loosening within the range.

描述: 跟随工艺数据初始化失败
原因: 跟随工艺数据存在错误或者系统繁忙
应对措施: 检查参数是否错误

描述: Failed to initialize tracking process data.
原因: There are errors in the tracking process data or the system is busy.
应对措施: Check for parameter errors.

描述: 中断运行结束，尝试恢复原任务运动轨迹失败
原因: 原任务轨迹恢复时,被异常终止,导致恢复失败;
应对措施: 重新设置启动行/返回起始行或者重新同步工程

描述: The interrupted operation is over, and the attempt to restore the original task trajectory failed.
原因: During the recovery of the original task trajectory, itDuring the recovery of the original task trajectory, it terminated due to an an it was abruptly terminated due to an anomaly, resulting in a failure to recover.
应对措施: Reset start line/return to start line or re-synchronise project.

描述: 中断队列已满
原因: 中断队列已被中断任务填满
应对措施: 1.检查中断触发条件是否过快，导致中断任务来不及处理；2.返回任务启动行，同步工程等操作可清除中断队列中的所有中断任务

描述: Interrupt queue is full
原因: The interrupt queue has been filled with interrupt tasks
应对措施: 1. Check whether the interrupt triggering condition is too fast, causing the interrupt task to be unable to process in time; 2. Return to the task start line, synchronize the project, and other operations can clear all interrupt tasks in the interrupt queue

描述: 出中断时，未回到中断前停止的点位
原因: 出中断时，没有调用指令将机器人恢复到进中断时的点位
应对措施: 出中断时，恢复到中断前的点位

描述: When an interruption occurs, it does not return to the point where it stopped before the interruption
原因: When an interrupt occurs, no command is called to restore the robot to the point at which the interrupt occurred
应对措施: When there is an interruption, restore to the point before the interruption

描述: 读写的TCP端口未打开
原因: TCP端口未开启
应对措施: 请确保Tcp端口已经正确连接

描述: TCP port for reading and writing is not open.
原因: The TCP port is not open.
应对措施: Make sure that the TCP port is properly connected.

描述: 动态网络通讯端口未关闭
原因: 动态网络通讯没有关闭情况下使用普通网络通讯
应对措施: 请通过指令CNVVIOSION OFF关闭动态网络通讯

描述: Dynamic network communication port not closed.
原因: Regular network communication is used without dynamic network communication being turned off.
应对措施: Turn off dynamic network communication using instruction CNVVIOSION OFF.

描述: 传送带错误或相机像素错误
原因: 传送带或相机的传输数据类型错误
应对措施: 重新设置传送带号或相机传输数据类型

描述: Conveyor error or camera pixel error
原因: The conveyor number is incorrect or the transfer data type of the camera is incorrect.
应对措施: Reset the conveyor number or camera data transfer type.

描述: 动态视觉坐标转换错误
原因: 动态视觉像素和相机坐标系转换出错
应对措施: 首先检查视觉发送过来的像素是否正确，否则需要重新标定相机

描述: Dynamic vision coordinates conversion error.
原因: Error converting dynamic vision pixels to camera coordinate system.
应对措施: Check that the pixels sent from vision equipment are correct, otherwise the camera needs to be recalibrated.

描述: 无后退数据
原因: 没有可以后退的数据
应对措施: 清除报错

描述: No reverse movement data found.
原因: There is no reverse movement data.
应对措施: Clear the error.

描述: 圆弧运动前缺乏运动指令
原因: 圆弧运动前一条指令不是Movj或Movl（仅在单步示教时出现）
应对措施: 保证圆弧指令前一条指令是为Movj或Movl

描述: Lack of motion instructions before arc instruction
原因: The instruction before arc motion is not Movj or Movl (This occurs only in the single-step teaching.)
应对措施: Ensure that the instruction before the arc instruction is Movj or Movl.

描述: 找不到指定文件
原因: 文件不存在或文件路径错误
应对措施: 检查文件是否存在或文件路径是否正确

描述: Specified file not found.
原因: The file does not exist or the file path is incorrect.
应对措施: Check that the file exists or the file path is correct.

描述: 保存诊断信息错误
原因: 保存诊断信息错误过程中相关文件不存在
应对措施: 系统内部错误，请联系厂家

描述: Error saving diagnostic information
原因: The relevant files do not exist during the process of saving diagnostic information.
应对措施: Internal system error, please contact the manufacturer.

描述: 导出诊断信息错误
原因: 导出诊断信息错误过程中相关文件不存在
应对措施: 首先请检查USB设备是否正常，否则为系统内部错误，请联系厂家

描述: Error exporting diagnostic information
原因: The relevant files do not exist during the process of exporting diagnostic information.
应对措施: Check that the USB device is normal; otherwise it is an internal system error, please contact the manufacturer.

描述: 文件数量超限或内存卡空间不足
原因: 1./media/sdcard1/文件夹下文件（含文件夹）数量过多? 2.SD卡剩余可使用空间过小
应对措施: 1.删除过多的文件，保证单个文件夹下的文件+文件夹数目不超过100个? 2.清理SD卡数据

描述: The number of files exceeds the limit or the SD card is out of space.
原因: 1. There are too many files (including folders) in /media/sdcard1. 2. The remaining usable space of the SD card is too small.
应对措施: 1. Delete excessive files and ensure the number of files plus folders in a single folder is not greater than 100. 2. Clean up the SD card.

描述: 暂停缓冲区数据发送失败
原因: 从暂停到启动时，缓冲数据发送失败
应对措施: 重新从停止开始启动

描述: Pause buffer data sending failed.
原因: Failed to send buffer data when going from pause to start.
应对措施: Restart from stop.

描述: 多任务编号不存在
原因: 任务编号写错或使用范围不对
应对措施: 检查任务编号

描述: Multitasking number does not exist.
原因: Multitasking number is written incorrectly or in the wrong range.
应对措施: Check the task number.

描述: 多任务编号错误或被占用
原因: 任务编号错误或已经被占用
应对措施: 检查任务编号

描述: Multitasking number incorrect or occupied.
原因: The multitasking number is incorrect or has been occupied.
应对措施: Check the task number.

描述: 多任务创建失败
原因: 系统繁忙；任务已经在运行或者暂中再次启动；非远程IO权限下启动0号任务；
应对措施: (1)重新运行XQT指令，检查是否正常运行；(2)停止当前多任务后再启动；(3)切换到远程权限再启动任务0；

描述: Multitasking creation failed.
原因: The system is busy; the task is already running or has been restarted; task 0 was started under non-remote I/O permissions.
应对措施: 1. Re-run the XQT command to check that it runs normally. 2. Stop the current multitasking and start it again. 3. Switch to remote I/O permissions and restart task 0.

描述: 开启或关闭位置锁存功能失败
原因: 硬件未连接或伺服未就绪
应对措施: 检查硬件连接和伺服配置

描述: Failed to open or close the position latching function.
原因: The hardware is not connected or the servo is not ready.
应对措施: Check the hardware connections and servo configuration.

描述: 控制器调试功能调用失败
原因: 控制器调试功能模块失效
应对措施: 检查控制器调试开关的配置是否正确

描述: Failed to call the controller debug function.
原因: The controller debug function module failed.
应对措施: Check that the configuration of the controller debug switch is correct.

描述: 负载参数设置失败
原因: 系统繁忙或参数超出范围
应对措施: 重新设置或检查参数

描述: Failed to set load parameters.
原因: The system is busy or the parameter is out of range.
应对措施: Reset or check the parameter.

描述: 串口号或波特率错误
原因: 1. 串口号输入范围不合适；
应对措施: 1. 检查串口号输入范围是否合适2. 使用close指令关闭串口，再用open指令开启新的波特率串口

描述: Serial port or baud rate error
原因: 1. The input serial port number is out of range. 2. With the serial port not closed, another serial port with the same number but different baud rate is opened.
应对措施: 1. Check that the input serial port number is within the range. 2. Close the serial port via the close instruction and open a serial port with new baud rate via the close instruction.

描述: Modbus参数读写错误
原因: Modbus读写执行失败
应对措施: 请更新软件版本

描述: Modbus parameter read-write error
原因: Modbus read-write execution failed
应对措施: Update the software version.

描述: P变量修改失败
原因: P变量所在的程序文件打开失败或写入失败
应对措施: 重新修改一次、更新软件版本

描述: Failed to modify P variable
原因: Failed to open or write the program file where the P variable is located.
应对措施: Re-modify it or update the software version.

描述: 网络通讯异常:客户端与服务器未建立连接
原因: 机器人与目标设备的通讯被中断
应对措施: 重新建立连接后再进行通讯

描述: Abnormal network communication: Client and server connection error.
原因: The communication between the robot and the target device has been interrupted.
应对措施: Reestablish the connection.

描述: 网络通讯异常:机器人发送数据出错
原因: 机器人网络通讯发送数据时断网或者传输数据时出错
应对措施: 检查网络连接是否正常

描述: Abnormal network communication: Robot sending data error.
原因: The network was disconnected while the robot was sending data or there was an error while transmitting data.
应对措施: Check that the network connection is normal.

描述: 姿态校正计算错误
原因: 工具选择错误或处于对准位置是奇异位置
应对措施: 1. 检查工具是否选择有误2. 检查机器人需要对准位置是否处于奇异

描述: Orientation correction calculation error
原因: Wrong tool was selected or the alignment position is a singularity.
应对措施: 1. Check that the tool selection is correct. 2. Check that the position that the robot needs to align with is not a singularity.

描述: Modbus模式下，切换工位程序错误
原因: Modbus模式下，当前工位程序处于非停止状态时,切换工位程序。
应对措施: 将当前工位程序设为停止状态，再切换工位程序。

描述: Error in switching station program in Modbus mode
原因: In Modbus mode, the station program is switched when the current station program is not stopped.
应对措施: Set the current station program to the stop state, and then switch the station program.

描述: 系统瞬间掉电错误
原因: 系统运行过程中突然断电
应对措施: 清除报警

描述: Supply voltage error
原因: The system suddenly loses power during operation.
应对措施: Clear the alarm.

描述: InoRobShop轴配置不合法
原因: InoRobShop配置的轴的数量或者类型不匹配
应对措施: 1、 在InRobShop重新配置正确的轴；2、 在示教器【设置】-【其他设置】清空PLC配置（注意：内置PLC程序也会丢失）

描述: Illegal InoRobShop axis configuration.
原因: The number or type of axes configured by InoRobShop does not match the actual condition.
应对措施: 1. Reconfigure the correct axis in InRobShop. 2. In InoTeachPad, go to Set > System > Others > Clear PLC-CFG and clear the PLC configuration (Note: The built-in PLC program will also be cleared.)

描述: Modbus模式下，选择多个程序错误
原因: Modbus模式下，同时选择多个工位程序
应对措施: 只选择一个工位程序。

描述: Error selecting multiple programs in Modbus mode
原因: In Modbus mode, multiple station programs are selected simultaneously.
应对措施: Select only one program.

描述: 示教器控制权下，手动模式运动过程中网络连接断开
原因: 当机器人在控制器权限下，且在手动模式，运动过程中检测到示教器与控制器的网络连接断开
应对措施: 重连后清除报警即可

描述: Network disconnected during motion in teach mode under teach pendant control.
原因: When the robot is under the control of teach pendant and operating in teach mode, it is detected that the network connection between the teach pendant and the controller is disconnected.
应对措施: Clear the alarm after reconnecting the teach pendant and the controller.

描述: 读写的串口未打开
原因: 读写的串口未打开
应对措施: 在控制器参数配置中打开串口，或者执行打开串口指令

描述: The read-write serial port is not opened.
原因: The read-write serial port is not opened.
应对措施: Open the serial port by configuring the controller parameter or by executing the open instruction.

描述: 未选择工位程序或程序运行过程中不允许修改P变量
原因: 未选择工位程序或程序运行过程中不允许修改P变量
应对措施: 请选择工位程序，或者确保当前处于停止状态

描述: P variable cannot be changed before a program is selected or when the program is running.
原因: P variable cannot be changed before a program is selected or when the program is running.
应对措施: Select a program or make sure that the robot is stopped.

描述: 客户端与服务器通讯超时，网络连接断开
原因: 客户端与服务器通讯超时，网络连接断开
应对措施: 请检查网络环境

描述: Client-server communication timeout, network connection lost.
原因: Client-server communication timeout, network connection lost.
应对措施: Check the network connection.

描述: 对方服务器已关闭，网络连接断开
原因: 对方服务器已关闭，网络连接断开
应对措施: 打开服务器

描述: Peer server shutdown, network connection lost.
原因: Opposite server has closed, network disconnected.
应对措施: Open the server.

描述: 检测J1伺服参数错误(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: J1一个或多个伺服参数错误
应对措施: 修改错误的伺服参数值后重启机器人

描述: J1 servo parameter error detected (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: One or more servo parameters of J1 are wrong.
应对措施: Reboot the robot after modifying the wrong servo parameter values.

描述: 检测J2伺服参数错误(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: J2一个或多个伺服参数错误
应对措施: 修改错误的伺服参数值后重启机器人

描述: J2 servo parameter error detected (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: One or more servo parameters of J2 are wrong.
应对措施: Reboot the robot after modifying the wrong servo parameter values.

描述: 检测J3伺服参数错误(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: J3一个或多个伺服参数错误
应对措施: 修改错误的伺服参数值后重启机器人

描述: J3 servo parameter error detected (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: One or more servo parameters of J3 are wrong.
应对措施: Reboot the robot after modifying the wrong servo parameter values.

描述: 检测J4伺服参数错误(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: J4一个或多个伺服参数错误
应对措施: 修改错误的伺服参数值后重启机器人

描述: J4 servo parameter error detected (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: One or more servo parameters of J4 are wrong.
应对措施: Reboot the robot after modifying the wrong servo parameter values.

描述: 检测J5伺服参数错误(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: J5一个或多个伺服参数错误
应对措施: 修改错误的伺服参数值后重启机器人

描述: J5 servo parameter error detected (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: One or more servo parameters of J5 are wrong.
应对措施: Reboot the robot after modifying the wrong servo parameter values.

描述: 检测J6伺服参数错误(修复错误后需重启生效)
原因: J6一个或多个伺服参数错误
应对措施: 修改错误的伺服参数值后重启机器人

描述: J6 servo parameter error detected (Reboot required after error is fixed).
原因: One or more servo parameters of J6 are wrong.
应对措施: Reboot the robot after modifying the wrong servo parameter values.

描述: 机器人软件版本和伺服版本不匹配
原因: 机器人软件版本和伺服版本不匹配
应对措施: 升级和机器人软件匹配的伺服版本

描述: Robot software version and servo version do not match.
原因: Robot software version and servo version do not match
应对措施: Upgrade the servo version to match the robot software.

描述: MC读M寄存器错误
原因: 1、MC未连接上；2、对端设备反馈报文格式错误。
应对措施: 1、检查对端PLC设置的协议类型、ip地址和端口号，以及确认机器人端设置的地址和端口号；

描述: The MC failed to read the M register.
原因: 1. MC not connected. 2. The format of the feedback message from the peer device is incorrect.
应对措施: 1. Check the protocol type, IP address, and port number set by the peer PLC, and confirm the address and port number set by the robot end.

描述: MC写M寄存器错误
原因: 1、MC未连接上；2、对端设备反馈报文格式错误。
应对措施: 1、检查对端PLC设置的协议类型、ip地址和端口号，以及确认机器人端设置的地址和端口号；

描述: The MC failed to write the M register.
原因: 1. MC not connected. 2. The format of the feedback message from the peer device is incorrect.
应对措施: 1. Check the protocol type, IP address, and port number set by the peer PLC, and confirm the address and port number set by the robot end.

描述: MC读D寄存器错误
原因: 1、MC未连接上；2、对端设备反馈报文格式错误。
应对措施: 1、检查对端PLC设置的协议类型、ip地址和端口号，以及确认机器人端设置的地址和端口号；

描述: The MC failed to read the D register.
原因: 1. MC not connected. 2. The format of the feedback message from the peer device is incorrect.
应对措施: 1. Check the protocol type, IP address, and port number set by the peer PLC, and confirm the address and port number set by the robot end.

描述: MC写D寄存器错误
原因: 1、MC未连接上；2、对端设备反馈报文格式错误。
应对措施: 1、检查对端PLC设置的协议类型、ip地址和端口号，以及确认机器人端设置的地址和端口号；

描述: The MC failed to write the D register.
原因: 1. MC not connected. 2. The format of the feedback message from the peer device is incorrect.
应对措施: 1. Check the protocol type, IP address, and port number set by the peer PLC, and confirm the address and port number set by the robot end.

描述: 伺服加速度参数设置失败
原因: 伺服加速度参数设置失败
应对措施: 检查伺服模块状态

描述: Failed to set servo acceleration parameter.
原因: Servo acceleration parameter setting failed.
应对措施: Check the servo module status.

描述: 恢复系统配置文件失败
原因: 恢复配置文件失败
应对措施: 重新保存配置文件或重启机器人

描述: Failed to recover system configuration profile.
原因: Failed to recover system configuration profile.
应对措施: Re-save the configuration file or restart the robot.

描述: 母线电压欠压

应对措施: 1、检查电源电压大小及是否稳定，更换或调整电源；2、若电源电压正常，检查空气开关处电压，若较低，排查电源线是否符合规格，并更换电源线至控制柜用户手册推荐的线缆；3、降低运行速度。

描述: Bus undervoltage.
原因: 1. The main circuit power supply voltage is low. 2. The power supply voltage drops during operation. 3. The power cord does not meet the specifications. 4. Main circuit powder supply dropout. 5. Controller fault.
应对措施: 1. Check the voltage and stability of the power supply, replace or regulate the power supply. 2. If the voltage is normal, check the voltage at the air-break switch. If it is low, check if the power cord meets the specifications and replace it if necessary. 3. Reduce operating speed.

描述: 母线电压过压
原因: 1、主回路输入电过高2、电源处于不稳定状态，或受到了雷击影响3、电机运行于急加减速状态，最大制动能量超过可吸收值4、母线电压采样值有较大偏差5、电柜故障
应对措施: 1、按照有效值220V-240V，允许偏差-10%~10%(198V~264V)规格，更换或调整电源2、接入浪涌抑制器后，再接通控制电和主回路电， 若仍然发生故障时，则更换伺服驱动器。3、首先确保主回路输入电压在规格范围内，其次在允许情况下增大加减速时间。4、咨询我司技术支持5、更换电柜

描述: Bus overvoltage.
原因: 1. The voltage input to the main circuit is too high. 2. The power supply is unstable or affected by lightning. 3. The motor is in abrupt deceleration status and the maximum braking energy exceeds the energy absorption value. 4. The bus voltage sampling value deviates greatly from the measured value. 5. Controller fault.
应对措施: 1. Replace or adjust the power supply according to the following specifications: 220V-240V±10% (198V to 264V). 2. Connect a surge protection device and then switch on the main circuit and control circuit power supplies again. If the fault persists, replace the servo drive. 3. After confirming the input voltage of the main circuit is within the specified range, increase the acceleration/deceleration time if the operating conditions allow. 4. Contact the technical support.

Check whether there are any components with abnormal temperature in the front chamber. The temperature control switch automatically resets when the ambient temperature drops to 45±5℃.3. The temperature control switch is faulty, replace it with a new one.

应对措施: 重新示教其他点计算圆弧

描述: Error calculating input arc parameters.
原因: Circular arc interpolation information cannot be calculated because: (1) At least two points are too close; (2) Three points are approximately in the same line; (3) Pose change is too large; (4) Transition is performed near a singularity.
应对措施: Re-teach the robot with other points to calculate the circular arc.

描述: 直线输入参数计算错误
原因: 无法计算出直线插补信息(1)姿态变化过大(2)奇异点附近过渡
应对措施: 重新示教其他点计算直线

描述: Error calculating input linear parameters.
原因: Linear interpolation information cannot be calculated because: (1) Pose change is too large; (2) Transition is performed near a singularity.
应对措施: Re-teach other points to calculate the line.

描述: 逆解运算错误

描述: Inverse kinematics error.
原因: The robot is at a singularity or out of reach.
应对措施: Disable the robot, switch to the joint mode and then move the robot out of the singularity, or change the target points to those that can be arrived.

描述: 奇异位置错误报警
原因: 机器人运动至奇异区域
应对措施: 切换至关节模式，移动机器人离开奇异位置

描述: Singular position error
原因: The robot moves to a singular position.
应对措施: Switch to the joint mode and move the robot out of the singular position.

描述: Reserved
原因: Reserved
应对措施: Reserved

描述: IO的序号访问范围超出
原因: IO访问物理端不存在
应对措施: 检查是否有对应的物理IO模块

描述: I/O index out of range.
原因: The physical I/O module does not exist.
应对措施: Check that the corresponding physical I/O module exists.

描述: jump参数设置错误
原因: MH设置参数在第3轴限位之外
应对措施: 修改限高或者重新选取起始位置、终点位置

描述: Jump parameter setting error
原因: MH parameter is beyond the limit of J3 axis.
应对措施: Modify the limit height or reselect a start or end point.

描述: 臂型参数错误
原因: 直线或圆弧运动时，终点前三个臂参数和起点不一致
应对措施: 修改运动为关节运动或者重新取点保证臂型一致

描述: Arm type parameter error
原因: Three arm type parameters before the end point are not consistent with those of the start point in linear or circular motion.
应对措施: Modify the motion to joint motion or reselect points to ensure consistent arm type.

描述: 设置运动特性参数不合理
原因: 运动参数输入范围不合理
应对措施: 重新修改速度以及加速度等运动参数

描述: Inappropriate motion characteristic parameters.
原因: The motion parameter input range is unreasonable.
应对措施: Modify motion parameters such as speed and acceleration.

描述: DA 操作错误
原因: 通道配置成电流输出，但使用了电压指令，或配置成电压，使用电流指令操作
应对措施: 使用与配置一致的指令操作DA端口

描述: DA operation error.
原因: The channel is configured as current output, but the voltage command is used. Or the channel is configured as voltage output, but the current command is used.
应对措施: Operate the DA port using a command consistent with the configuration.

描述: 发出伺服使能命令，但实际反馈未使能
原因: (1)伺服主电未上(2)关节是否在减速过程中(3)关节还处在运动状态，没有到位
应对措施: (1)检查控制柜的强电按钮是否按下(2)停止和启动或上伺服之间的间隔时间太短(3)检查关节是否到位。放大到位误差，或调整伺服参数。(4)状态字反馈过慢；

描述: The command to enable servo was sent, but the servo was not enabled actually.
原因: 1. The main power supply of the servo is not switched on. 2. The joint may be in deceleration process. 3. The joint is in motion state and does not arrive at the position.
应对措施: 1. Check whether the strong current button of the controller is pressed down. 2. The interval between servo stop and start or enable is too short. 3. Check whether the joint arrives at the position. Amplify the arrival error or adjust the servo parameters. 4. Status word feedback is too slow.

描述: 关节运动输入参数错误
原因: (1)针对delta机型，在空间范围外(2)MoveJ与MOVL或MOVC在奇异附近过渡
应对措施: (1)针对delta机型，检查点位是否在空间范围外(2)检查MoveJ与MOVL或MOVC是否在奇异附近过渡

描述: Joint motion parameter input error
原因: 1. The points are beyond the space range for the Delta robots. 2. MoveJ and MOVL or MOVC performs transition near a singularity.
应对措施: 1. Check whether the points are beyond the space range for the Delta robots. 2. Check whether MoveJ and MOVL or MOVC performs transition near a singularity.

描述: 机器人未回零
原因: 使用增量编码器时机器人未进行回零操作
应对措施: 对于增量编码器，先进行回零操作

描述: Robot not returned to zero.
原因: The robot does not perform the homing operation when an incremental encoder is used.
应对措施: For incremental encoder, perform the homing operation first.

描述: 机器人半径方向越界
原因: 机器人末端X、Y合成半径大于设定的半径
应对措施: 在直角坐标系下，jog使机器人末端X、Y合成半径减小的方向运动

描述: Robot radial direction out of bound.
原因: The X and Y combined radius at the end of the robot is greater than the set radius.
应对措施: Under the rectangular coordinate system, step so that the robot end moves in the direction of reduction of the X and Y combined radius.

描述: 机器人 Z 正方向越界
原因: 机器人末端Z大于设定值
应对措施: 在直角坐标系下，jog使机器人末端朝Z负方向运动

描述: Robot Z positive direction out of bound.
原因: The Z at the end of the robot is greater than the setpoint.
应对措施: Under the rectangular coordinate system, step so that the robot end moves in the negative direction of Z.

描述: 机器人 Z 负方向越界
原因: 机器人末端Z小于设定值
应对措施: 在直角坐标系下，jog使机器人末端朝Z正方向运动

描述: Robot Z negative direction out of bound.
原因: The Z at the end of the robot is smaller than the setpoint.
应对措施: Under the rectangular coordinate system, step so that the robot end moves in the negative direction of Z.

描述: 机器人越界
原因: 在线运行时，示教点越界
应对措施: 更改点位，使点处于机器人工作空间内

描述: Robot out of bound.
原因: The teaching point exceeds the boundary.
应对措施: Change the teaching points so that they are within the work space of the robot.

描述: 系统线程优先级异常
原因: 运行过程中监测到系统线程优先级异常
应对措施: 请导出诊断信息，联系厂家处理

描述: System thread priority exception.
原因: System thread priority exception detected during operation.
应对措施: Export the diagnostic information and contact the manufacturer.

描述: 实时任务同步超时
原因: 实时任务同步超时
应对措施: 请导出诊断信息，联系厂家处理

描述: Real time task synchronization timeout.
原因: Real time task synchronization timeout.
应对措施: Export the diagnostic information and contact the manufacturer.

描述: 码垛机器人的2、3轴夹角太小
原因: 码垛机器人的2、3轴夹角太小
应对措施: 手动模式下，正向转动第3轴，或负向转动第2轴

描述: The included angle between J2 and J3 axes of the palletizing robot is too small.
原因: The included angle between J2 and J3 axes of the palletizing robot is too small.
应对措施: In the manual mode, rotate the J3 axis positively or the J2 axis negatively.

描述: 码垛机器人的2、3轴夹角太大
原因: 码垛机器人的2、3轴夹角太大
应对措施: 手动模式下，正向转动第3轴，或负向转动第2轴

描述: The included angle between J2 and J3 axes of the palletizing robot is too large.
原因: The included angle between J2 and J3 axes of the palletizing robot is too large.
应对措施: In the manual mode, rotate the J3 axis positively or the J2 axis negatively.

描述: 机器人速度异常
原因: 机器人关节速度超出了允许的最大速度的两倍
应对措施: (1)确保设置界面的关节最大允许速度和关节最大允许加速度设置合理(2)确保机器人不在在奇异位置附近(3)降低直线运动的速度

描述: Abnormal robot speed.
原因: The robot joint speed exceeds twice the allowable maximum speed.
应对措施: 1. Ensure that the allowable maximum speed and acceleration of joints are reasonably set. 2. Ensure that the robot is not near a singularity. 3. Reduce the linear motion speed.

描述: 运动参数错误
原因: 运动规划参数异常
应对措施: 检查运动参数（速度、加速度）的设置是否合理

描述: Motion parameter error.
原因: The motion planning parameters are abnormal.
应对措施: Check that the motion parameters (speed, acceleration) are reasonable.

描述: 机器人位置速度或姿态速度超过设定值
原因: 机器人末端运动速度超出了设定的位置速度或姿态速度
应对措施: (1)如果使用了MoveJ指令，请将MoveJ速度系数设小(2)检查设置的姿态速度与J4关节速度是否一致

描述: The position speed or orientation speed exceeds the setting value.
原因: The robot end motion exceeds the set position or orientation speed.
应对措施: 1. If the MoveJ instruction is used, set the MoveJ speed coefficient to a smaller value. 2. Check whether the set orientation speed is consistent with the J4 joint speed.

描述: 换臂型错误
原因: 在奇异附近，不支持换臂型指令（Scara专用）
应对措施: 替换成一个远离奇异区域的点，再调用换臂型指令

描述: Arm type change error.
原因: The arm type change instruction (specially used for SCARA robots) is not supported near a singularity.
应对措施: Replace the point with a point far from the singularity and then call the arm type change instruction.

描述: 机器人加速度异常
原因: 机器人关节速度超出了允许的最大加速度的50倍
应对措施: (1)确保设置页面的关节最大允许速度和关节最大允许加速度设置合理(2)确保机器人不在奇异位置附近(3)降低直线运动的速度和加速度

描述: The robot acceleration is abnormal.
原因: The robot joint speed exceeds 50 times the allowable maximum acceleration.
应对措施: 1. Ensure that the allowable maximum speed and acceleration of joints are reasonably set. 2. Ensure that the robot is not near a singularity. 3. Reduce the speed and acceleration of the linear motion.

描述: 速度设置异常
原因: DSP内部存储区不足
应对措施: 降低直角设置速度，或增加关节设置速度

描述: Speed setting error
原因: Insufficient internal storage in DSP.
应对措施: Decrease the Cartesian speed or increase the joint speed.

描述: 速度设置异常
原因: DSP内部样条存储区不足
应对措施: 降低位置姿态设置速度，或增加关节设置速度

描述: The setting velocity is abnormal.
原因: Insufficient internal spline storage in DSP.
应对措施: Reduce the position and orientation speed, or increase the joint speed.

描述: 机器人工作下界设置过大或者停止距离设置过小
原因: 跟随中机器人工作下界过大或者停止距离过小
应对措施: 优先减小下界，其次选择增大机器人停止距离

描述: The lower worksapce boundary is too large or the stop distance is too small.
原因: The lower worksapce boundary is too large or the stop distance is too small for the tracking process.
应对措施: Decrease the lower worksapce boundary, and then increase the stop distance.

描述: 机器人超出工作范围下界
原因: 在跟随过程中超出了设定的工作范围
应对措施: 根据传输带参数设置说明，调整工作下界、拾取上界；提高机器人速度；降低传送带速度。

描述: Robot out of lower worksapce boundary.
原因: The robot exceeds the set workspace in the tracking process.
应对措施: Adjust the lower worksapce boundary and the upper pickup boundary; increase the robot speed; reduce the conveyor speed.

描述: 传送带速度过大
原因: 传送带速度超出合理范围
应对措施: 传输带速度超出最大速度限制（线性传输带最大1m/s，旋转传输盘最大180度/s）

描述: Conveyor speed too large.
原因: The conveyor speed exceeds a reasonable range.
应对措施: The conveyor speed exceeds the maximum speed limit (1 m/s for the linear conveyor and 180°/s for the turntable conveyor).

描述: 传送带速度波动过大
原因: 传送带速度波动
应对措施: 检查传输带电机是否存在速度波动过大或者传输带有异常

描述: Conveyor speed fluctuation too large
原因: The conveyor speed fluctuates excessively.
应对措施: Check that the conveyor motor speed does not fluctuate excessively or that the conveyor is abnormal.

描述: 长期未接收到视觉返回数据，超时
原因: 发送视觉触发信号后长期未收到返回数据，视觉处理周期大于拍照时间间隔
应对措施: (1)检查视觉触发信号是否下发成功；(2)若视觉触发信号每次都下发成功，则检查相机是否每次都会进行正常拍照，即排查相机是否发生漏拍现象；(3)视觉软件处理时间太长，或数据发送延迟太长；

描述: Vision data waiting timeout.
原因: No returned data is received for a long period of time after vision triggering signals are sent, and the vision processing cycle is greater than the photographing interval.
应对措施: 1. Check whether the vision trigger signal is delivered successfully. 2. If the vision trigger signal is delivered successfully every time, check whether the camera will take pictures normally every time. 3. The processing time of vision software is too long, or the delay time of data transmission is too long.

描述: 机器人工件参数类型错误
原因: 跟随运动中使用了带有Wobj参数的运动指令，或普通运动中使用了带有Cnv参数的运动指令
应对措施: 处于跟随状态下的运动指令的工件参数需修改为Cnv，处于普通运动中的运动指令的工件参数需修改为Wobj

描述: Workobject parameter type error.
原因: A motion instruction with Wobj parameter is used in tracking motion，or a motion instruction with Cnv parameter is used in normal motion.
应对措施: The workobject parameter of the motion instruction in the tracking motion shall be modified to Cnv, and the workobject parameter of the motion instruction in the normal motion shall be modified to Wobj.

描述: 动态点坐标错误
原因: 给定的动态目标位置错误、奇异或出界
应对措施: 检查视觉给出的做坐标是否在合理范围内

描述: Dynamic point coordinate error.
原因: The given dynamic target position is incorrect, singular or out of bounds.
应对措施: Check that the coordinate given by vision is within a reasonable range.

描述: 传送带跟随命令语法错误
原因: 连续使用了Refsys Convyor或Refsys Base
应对措施: 检查是否Refsys Convyor和Refsys Base配对使用

描述: Syntax error in conveyor tracking instruction.
原因: Refsys Convyor or Refsys Base is used continuously.
应对措施: Check that RefConvyor and RefBase are jointly used.

描述: 建立抓取工件坐标系失败
原因: 没执行GetCnvObject就执行Refsys Convyor
应对措施: 先调用GetCnvObject指令，后跟随

描述: Failed to establish coordinate system for grasping the work object.
原因: The Refsys Convyor instruction is executed before the GetCnvObject instruction is executed.
应对措施: Call the GetCnvObject instruction first.

描述: 传送带视觉端口错误
原因: 使用了多个视觉传送带
应对措施: 检查是否同时使用了2个以上视觉输入

描述: Conveyor vision port error.
原因: Multiple conveyors adopting vision detection are used.
应对措施: Check whether more than two vision inputs are used at the same time.

描述: 不允许单步示教
原因: 传送带跟随相关指令不允许单步示教
应对措施: 不允许对Refsys Convyor和Refsys Base之间的指令进行单步操作

描述: Single-step teaching is not allowed.
原因: The conveyor tracking-related instructions do not allow single-step teaching.
应对措施: Single-step operation on instructions between Refsys Convyor and Refsys Base is not allowed.

描述: 指令中使用了未使能的传送带
原因: 指令中使用了未使能的传送带
应对措施: 检查程序中使用的传送带编号，看是否使能

描述: A disabled conveyor is used in the instruction.
原因: A disabled conveyor is used in the instruction.
应对措施: Check whether the conveyor used in the program is disabled.

描述: 跟随过程中不允许PTP运动
原因: 跟随工艺中使用了MovJ，JumP等关节运动
应对措施: 检查Refsys Convyor和Refsys Base之间是否使用了MovJ或者jump指令

描述: PTP motion is not allowed in the tracking process.
原因: Joint motions such as MovJ and JumP are used in the tracking process.
应对措施: Check whether the MovJ or jump instruction is used between Refsys Convyor and Refsys Base.

描述: 传送带方向错误
原因: 传送带方向错误
应对措施: (1)检查传输带界面中的编码器的方向参数是否正确(2)检查传输带是否有打滑现象

描述: The conveyor belt is in the wrong direction
原因: The conveyor belt is in the wrong direction
应对措施: 1. Check that the encoder direction parameter on the conveyor setting interface is correct. 2. Check that the conveyor is not slipping.

描述: 直角示教启动的位置在奇异无法逆解的位置
原因: 直角示教启动的位置在奇异位置，无法逆解
应对措施: 切换关节模式移出奇异位置

描述: The start position for teaching in Cartesian system is at a singular position where inverse kinematic solution cannot be executed.
原因: The start position for teaching in Cartesian system is at a singular position where inverse kinematic solution is impossible.
应对措施: Switch to joint mode and move out of the singular position.

描述: 各轴锁存计数器不一致
原因: 锁存机器人位置时，各轴锁存计数器不一致，伺服反馈的锁存状态有误，可能是锁存IO在静态、动态、xqt任务中有被调用
应对措施: 请检查各轴的锁存信号是否有效，检查锁存IO在静态、动态、xqt任务中有被调用，若被调用，请将其他任务中用到的锁存IO换用

描述: Inconsistent latch counters.
原因: The robot position latching counters of the respective axes are inconsistent, resulting in incorrect latch state feedback from the servo. The latch I/O may have been called in static, dynamic, or xqt task.
应对措施: Check that the latching signals of the respective axes are active. Check if the latch I/O has been called in static, dynamic, or xqt task. If it is called, change the latch I/O used in other tasks.

描述: 锁存缓存已满
原因: 锁存机器人位置时，锁存缓存已满
应对措施: 锁存速度太快，或者锁存太多并未使用

描述: Latching buffer full.
原因: When the robot position is latched, the latching buffer is full.
应对措施: The latching speed is too fast, or there are too many latched positions that are not used.

描述: J1或J2关节运动范围超过180度
原因: 倒装scara插补运动时，轴1、轴2关节运动范围超过180°，无法保证插补运动终点角度与预定角度一致
应对措施: 避免出现上述情形

描述: The motion range of J1 or J2 exceeds 180°.
原因: When the inverted SCARA robot performs interpolation motion, the motion range of J1 or J2 axis exceeds 180°, making it impossible to ensure that the termination angle of interpolation motion is consistent with the predetermined angle.
应对措施: Avoid the above situations.

描述: J2关节运动范围穿越奇异点
原因: 倒装scara插补运动时，轴2关节运动范围穿越奇异点，无法保证插补运动终点角度与预定角度一致
应对措施: 避免出现上述情形

描述: The motion range of J2 passes through the singular point.
原因: When the inverted SCARA robot performs interpolation motion, the J1 axis moves through the singularity, making it impossible to ensure that the termination angle of interpolation motion is consistent with the predetermined angle.
应对措施: Avoid the above situations.

描述: EtherCAT通信反馈异常
原因: EtherCAT总线反馈数据丢失
应对措施: 查看Ethercat网线是否松动，是否因外部原因对信号造成干扰

描述: EtherCAT communication feedback error.
原因: EtherCAT bus feedback data is missing.
应对措施: Check that the EtheCAT cable is properly connected and there is no external interference.

描述: 平衡缸弹簧已到维保时间
原因: 平衡缸弹簧已达设定寿命阈值，若继续使用可能存在器件损坏风险
应对措施: 请及时联系厂家维保

描述: Balance cylinder spring has reached maintenance time
原因: The balance cylinder spring has reached the set lifespan threshold, and there may be a risk of component damage if continued use
应对措施: Please contact the manufacturer for maintenance in a timely manner

描述: 位置锁存超时
原因: 1、伺服未正确配置探针功能；2、未触发正确IO沿信号；3、硬件干扰；
应对措施: 1、检查是否输出有效沿信号；2、检查伺服探针是否配置；3、检查硬件干扰；

描述: Position latch timeout.
原因: 1. The servo is not properly configured with probe function. 2. The correct I/O edge signal is not triggered. 3. Hardware interference.
应对措施: 1. Check if a valid edge signal is output. 2. Check if the servo probe is configured. 3. Check for hardware interference.

描述: 规划轨迹中有触发限位
原因: 规划的轨迹触发限位
应对措施: 检查对应段的规划轨迹，中间过程点是否有触发限位

描述: Limit-triggering point present in planned trajectory.
原因: The planned trajectory includes points that may trigger the limit.
应对措施: Check the corresponding motion segment for points that may trigger limit.

描述: 轨迹速度约束过小
原因: (1)规划中，计算出的空间速度约束过小，速度参数设置不正确(2)轨迹中接近奇异区
应对措施: (1)调整设置的速度参数(2)调整轨迹远离奇异区

描述: The constraint of velocity in trajectory is very low.
原因: 1. In the planning, the calculated spatial velocity constraint is too small, and the velocity parameters are set incorrectly. 2. The trajectory is close to a singularity.
应对措施: 1. Adjust the set speed parameters. 2. Adjust the trajectory away from the singularity.

描述: 规划轨迹中有无法逆解的位置
原因: 规划轨迹中间点无法逆解计算
应对措施: 修改出错段的位置取点

描述: Path planning: inverse kinematics error.
原因: Inverse kinematic solution cannot be executed at an intermediate point of the planned trajectory.
应对措施: Modify points in the erroneous section of trajectory.

描述: 动态跟随预处理位置超出工作下界
原因: 动态跟随预处理时检测到目标点超出工作下界

描述: 急停的硬件信号有效

描述: Valid hardware signal for emergency stop.

描述: 模式切换超时
原因: 1、机器人加速度设置过小导致停机时间过长；2、运动状态下切换模式；
应对措施: 1、检查运动参数设置是否正确；将当前运动停止并确保机器人处于静止时再切换模式；2、将当前运动停止并确保机器人处于静止时再切换模式

描述: Mode switch timeout.
原因: 1. The robot's acceleration setting, resulting in the robot stop overtime. 2. The robot is moving while switching mode.
应对措施: 1. Check that the motion parameters are set correctly. 2. Stop the current motion and make sure the robot is stationary before switching the mode.

描述: Power error
原因: 1. The input power supply is abnormal. 2. System hardware failure.
应对措施: View the servo parameter H0B-45 and handle the problem according to the user guide.

描述: Fan error

应对措施: View the servo parameter H0B-45 and handle the problem according to the user guide.

描述: 数据采集板连接失败
原因: 机器人控制器和数据采集板之间的通讯断开
应对措施: 请按如下顺序检查确认：1、检测控制柜上面的编码器线是否连接牢固；2、检查数据采集板上的线缆和插头是否连接完好；3、检查是否安装了数据采集板；4、检查数据采集板连接的灯是否正常（绿灯闪烁）；5、检查数据采集板是否有刷固件；若检查确认后还是发生报警，可以尝试更换数据采集板；

描述: Data acquisition board communication failure.
原因: Communication between robot controller and data acquisition board is disconnected.
应对措施: 1. Check that the signal cable is connected. 2. Check that data acquisition board cable is connected. 3. Check that data acquisition board is installed. 4. Check that data acquisition board light is working improperly (green light flashing). 5. Check that data acquisition board has firmware.

描述: 数据采集板数据异常
原因: 数据采集板损坏
应对措施: 请按如下顺序检查确认：1、检查数据采集板连接的灯是否正常（绿灯闪烁）；2、检查重新上电后报警是否可消除；3、检查控制柜上电时序是否正常；若检查确认后还是发生报警，可以尝试更换数据采集板；

描述: Data acquisition board data error.
原因: The data collection board is damaged.
应对措施: 1. Check that data acquisition board light is working improperly (green light flashing). 2. Check whether the alarm can be cleared after restart. 3. Check that the controller's power-up timing is normal. If the alarm persists, replace the data acquisition board.

描述: 数据采集板通讯异常
原因: 数据采集板通讯数据丢帧
应对措施: 请按如下顺序检查确认：1、检测控制柜上面的编码器线是否连接牢固；2、检查数据采集板上的线缆和插头是否连接完好；3、检查机器人运动过程中是否会导致数据采集板插头受力接触不良；4、检查数据采集板硬件电路是否正常工作 ；5、检查重新上电后报警是否可消除；若检查确认后还是发生报警，可以尝试更换数据采集板；

描述: Data acquisition board communication error.
原因: The data acquisition board encounters data frame loss.
应对措施: 1. Check that signal cable is connected. 2. Check that data acquisition board cable is connected. 3. Check that the robot motion does not result in poor contact with the data acquisition board connector due to force during robot motion. 4. Check that the data acquisition board hardware circuit works properly.5. Check whether the alarm can be cleared after restart.  If the alarm persists, replace the data acquisition board.

描述: 数据采集板数据变化过快
原因: 机器人与环境发生碰撞；机器人运动过程中存在明显异响；
应对措施: 请按如下顺序检查确认：1、检查机器人是否与环境发生碰撞；2、检测机器人运动速度和加速度是否过大；若检查确认后还是发生报警，可以尝试更换数据采集板；

描述: Data acquisition board data changed significantly.
原因: Robot collides with environment; robot moves with abnormal sound.
应对措施: 1. Check whether robot collides with environment. 2. Check whether robot speed and acceleration is too high. If the alarm persists, replace the data acquisition board.

描述: 数据采集板温度超限
原因: 数据采集板温度超限
应对措施: 请按如下顺序检查确认：1、检查机器人工作环境的温度是否满足要求；若检查确认后还是发生报警，可以尝试降低机器人运动速度或加速度；

描述: Data acquisition board overtemperature.
原因: Data acquisition board overtemperature.
应对措施: 1. Check that the temperature of the robot's working environment meets the requirements. . If the alarm persists, reduce the speed and acceleration of the robot.

描述: 机器人振动过大
原因: 机器人振动过大
应对措施: 请按如下顺序检查确认：1、检查机器人是否出现明显振动；2、检查机器人各关节是否存在明显传动间隙；若检查确认后还是发生报警，可以尝试降低机器人运动速度或加速度；

描述: Excessive robot vibration.
原因: Excessive robot vibration.
应对措施: 1. Check the robot for visible vibrations. 2. Check the robot joints for obvious transmission clearance. If the alarm persists, reduce the speed and acceleration of the robot.

描述: 机器人定位时间过长
原因: 机器人残余振动明显，定位时间过长
应对措施: 请按如下顺序检查确认：1、检查机器人是否出现明显振动；2、检查机器人各关节是否存在明显传动间隙；

描述: Robot positioning time too long.
原因: Residual robot vibration is significant, resulting in long positioning time.
应对措施: 1. Check the robot for visible vibrations. 2. Check the robot joints for obvious transmission clearance. If the alarm persists, reduce the speed and acceleration of the robot.

描述: 碰撞检测
原因: 机器人与环境发生碰撞；机器人运动过程中存在明显异响
应对措施: 检查机器人是否与环境发生碰撞，检测机器人运动过程中是否存在异响

描述: Collision detected.
原因: Robot collides with environment; robot moves with abnormal sound.
应对措施: Check whether the robot collides with the environment; check whether there are abnormal noises during the robot motion.

描述: 振动抑制功能失效

应对措施: 请按如下顺序检查确认：1、检测控制柜上面的编码器线是否连接牢固；2、检查数据采集板上的线缆和插头是否连接完好；3、检查重新上电后报警是否可消除；若检查确认后还是发生报警，可以尝试关闭闭环振动抑制功能；

描述: Vibration reduction failure.
原因: Vibration reduction failure.
应对措施: 1. Check that signal cable is connected. 2. Check that data acquisition board cable is connected. 3. Check whether the alarm can be cleared after restart;If the alarm persists, turn off the closed loop vibration suppression function.

描述: 机器人运动状态异常
原因: 1、软件机型号与实际不一致；2、机械原因：如发生碰撞，传动机构松动或卡滞；3、机器人零点偏差过大；4、关节减速比设置错误；5、关节运动方向反向；6、数据采集板安装方向错误；
应对措施: 请按如下顺序检查确认：1、确保控制器软件机型号与实际一致；2、检查是否存在机械异常：如发生碰撞，传动机构松动或卡滞；3、检查机器人零点是否准确无误；4、检查设置的减速比参数是否与设计一致；5、检查关节运动方向是否与定义一致；6、检查板数据采集板安装方向是否准确；若检查确认后还是发生报警，可以尝试关闭数据采集板报警功能；

描述: Robot motion state error.
原因: 1. The robot model in software is not consistent with actual one. 2. Mechanical causes: collision or loose or stuck transmission mechanism. 3. Home position deviation is too large. 4. Reduction ratio setting error. 5. Joint motion direction error. 6. Data acquisition board install direction error.
应对措施: 1. Make sure the robot model in software is the same as with the actual one. 2. Check for mechanical anomalies such as collision, loose or stuck drive mechanism. 3. Check that the zero point of the robot is accurate. 4. Check that the reduction ratio parameter is correctly set. 5. Check that the direction of joint movement is correct. 6. Check that the data acquisition board is mounted in the correct direction. If the alarm persists, turn off data acquisition board alarm function.

应对措施: 降低运动速度；关闭自学习振动抑制功能；

描述: Self-learning vibration reduction function calculation error.
原因: Self-learning vibration reduction function calculation error.
应对措施: Reduce the motion speed; turn off the self-learning vibration suppression function.

描述: Data acquisition board self-test failure.

应对措施: 1. Check if the encoder cable and data acquisition board cable are hot swapped. 2. Check whether data acquisition board chips are damaged. 3. Check whether the alarm can be cleared after restart.

描述: 检测到J1轴异常，请确认是否发生碰撞；如无碰撞，请确认该轴电机是否发生故障，排查外部线缆干涉、拉扯的情况；如无异常，确认负载参数设置是否正确、确认碰撞检测参数是否已调试；若仍无异常请参考说明书排查原因或调试碰撞检测参数。
原因: 请确认是否发生碰撞；如无碰撞，请确认该轴电机是否发生故障；如无异常，确认负载参数设置是否正确、确认碰撞检测参数是否已调试、确认是否由于伺服跟踪能力有限造成；如无异常，确认机器人是否存在长时间冷机或长时间运行后摩擦力显著变化的情况；若仍无异常请参考说明书排查原因或调试碰撞检测参数。
应对措施: 请确认是否发生碰撞，若未发生碰撞，请：1）检查负载参数是否设置正确；2）检查控制器中的机器人型号是否与本体一致；3）检查机器人是否出现电机卡死、抱闸未打开等情况；4）若存在机器人长时间冷机后突然启动的情况，请适当热机后再运行；若存在长时间运行后机器人摩擦力显著降低的情况，须联系厂商重新辨识摩擦力；5）若工作在高速重载等工况下，导致电流出现了饱和现象，此时也很容易发生误报警，这种工况已经超出机器人的负载能力，需要避免工作在这种条件下；也可尝试通过指令进入中等精度模式或手动打开所有轴的速度前馈在一定程度上解决该问题。6）若确定为误报，可适当调大该轴的碰撞检测灵敏度，建议使用碰撞检测灵敏度推荐值；7）若仍无效，可尝试关闭该轴的碰撞检测开关.

描述: An abnormality has been detected on the J1 axis. Please confirm if a collision has occurred. If no collision has occurred, please check if the motor of this axis has malfunctioned,check for any external cable interference or pulling issues. If no issues are found, verify if the load parameters are correctly set and if the collision detection parameters have been properly calibrated. 描述: 检测到J1轴运动状态异常
原因: 1、机器人发生碰撞；或因负载参数、机型参数严重错误、零点严重偏离导致电流异常。2、伺服故障，可能的故障类型有：动力线UVW相序错误、电机电角度错误、编码器型号不匹配、编码器接线故障、伺服增益不匹配等。 3、机器人运动速度、加速度过大，超出当前机器人的运动能力，造成速度偏差和转矩偏差过大。
应对措施: 在排查此故障时，当任一轴电机上使能前，请务必确保相关人员在机器人的工作范围之外！1、首先确认是否发生过剧烈碰撞，若未发生碰撞，检查是否正确设置负载参数，检查机器人本体与控制器中显示的机型是否匹配，检查机器人零点是否有严重偏离。2、若未发生碰撞且无明显异常，尝试增大伺服增益、打开伺服速度前馈（可通过指令进入中等精度模式打开速度前馈），看是否仍然报警。3、若排除碰撞和控制器端的因素，接下来依次排查伺服端的因素。1）、U V W相序接线错误。处理措施：按照正确U V W相序接线。2）、上电时，干扰信号导致电机转子初始相位检测错误。处理方法：重新上电。4、编码器型号错误或接线错误。处理方法：重新确认电机型号，确认H00-00参数是否正确，编码器类型，编码器接线。5、编码器接线错误、老化腐蚀，编码器插头松动。处理方法：重新焊接、插紧或更换编码器线缆。6、参数设置不合理导致伺服运行振动过大。处理方法：设置合适的参数避免伺服运行振动过大。更多参见手册中附录《机器人报警及处理方法》

描述: Abnormal motion state is detected in axis 1
原因: 1. Robot collision; or abnormal current due to serious errors in load parameters, model parameters, and serious deviation of zero point. 2. Servo faults, including: power line UVW phase sequence error, motor angle error, encoder model mismatch, encoder wiring failure, servo gain mismatch, etc. 3. Robot motion speed and acceleration are too large, exceeding the robot's motion capability, resulting in excessive speed deviation and torque deviation.
应对措施: When troubleshooting, always make sure that the person is outside the robot's operating range before activating the motor on any axis! 1. First check if a violent collision has occurred, if no collision occurs, check that the load parameters are set correctly, check that the robot matches the model displayed in the controller, and check if there is a serious deviation from the zero point of the robot. 2. 描述: 不支持的功能
原因: 22版本第一阶段暂不支持的功能（如跟随工艺）
应对措施: 删除含有不支持功能的相关指令；

描述: Unsupported feature
原因: Features not currently supported in the first phase of version 22 (such as tracking).
应对措施: Delete related instructions containing unsupported features.

描述: 快抓指令预处理规划错误
原因: 进行快抓指令预处理时无水平规划段
应对措施: 适当修改快抓指令的运动起点，保证快抓指令在运动过程中存在水平段的运动

描述: CnvFastCatch instruction preprocessing planning error.
原因: There is no horizontal planning section during preprocessing of CnvFastCatch instruction.
应对措施: Modify the starting point of the CnvFastCatch instruction appropriately to ensure that there is a horizontal movement during the movement of the CnvFastCatch instruction.

描述: 传送带编号不一致
原因: GetCnvObject指令与RefSys Conveyor、CnvFastCatch指令之间的传送带编号不一致
应对措施: 将GetCnvObject指令与RefSys Conveyor、CnvFastCatch指令之间的传送带编号修改为一致

描述: Conveyor index inconsistent.
原因: Conveyor index is inconsistent between GetCnvObject instruction and RefSys Conveyor instruction, or between GetCnvObject instruction and CnvFastCatch instruction.
应对措施: Modify conveyor index to be consistent between the GetCnvObject instruction and the RefSys Conveyor and CnvFastCatch instructions.

描述: 传送带指令使用冲突
原因: 同时使用了RefSys Conveyor指令与CnvFastCatch指令
应对措施: RefSys Conveyor指令和CnvFastCatch指令之间必须要有RefSys Base指令隔开

描述: Conveyor instruction conflict.
原因: RefSys Conveyor instruction and CnvFastCatch instruction are used at the same time.
应对措施: RefSys Conveyor instruction and CnvFastCatch instruction must be separated by RefSys Base instruction.

描述: 传送带指令工具参数错误
原因: 跟随运动中的运动指令所使用的工具为非夹持属性
应对措施: 将跟随运动中的运动指令所使用的工具切换为夹持属性的工具

描述: Error in tool parameter of conveyor instruction.
原因: The tool used in tracking motion instruction is not a gripping tool.
应对措施: Switch the tool used in tracking motion instruction to a gripping tool.

描述: 激活的传送带所关联的工件坐标系参数错误
原因: 激活的传送带所关联的工件属性为工件夹持或用户坐标系非固定
应对措施: 激活的传送带所关联的工件切换为工件非夹持且用户坐标系固定的工件

描述: Error in parameter of workobject frame associated with the active conveyor.
原因: The attribute of workobject frame associated with the active conveyor: (1) the workobject is not held; or (2) the user frame is not fixed.
应对措施: Switch the workobject frame connected with the active conveyor to the workobject frame whose workobject is held and user frame is fixed.

描述: 跟随工艺不支持“机器人位于可移动导轨上”的安装方式
原因: 跟随工艺不支持“机器人位于可移动导轨上”的安装方式
应对措施: 在“机械单元配置”的属性页面中修改为“机器人在固定位置”选项

描述: The tracking process does not support the installation of robot on a movable guide rail.
原因: The tracking process does not support the installation of robot on a movable guide rail.
应对措施: Change the installation mode of the robot to "Robot in Fixed Position" on the mechanical unit configuration interface.

描述: CnvTrigVis指令使用错误
原因: 非“视觉+指令”检测方式的传送带不允许使用CnvTrigVis指令
应对措施: 将该传送带的检测方式改为“视觉+指令”或者切换成检测方式为“视觉+指令”的传送带

描述: CnvTrigVis instruction use error.
原因: The CnvTrigVis instruction is not allowed for the conveyor whose detection mode is not "vision+instruction".
应对措施: Change the detection mode of the conveyor to "vision+instruction" or switch to a conveyor with the detection mode of "vision+instruction".

描述: 传感器触发频率过高
原因: 来料过密，导致传感器触发周期 小于 0.6 s，从而会导致拍照频率过高
应对措施: 减小传感器触发的频率

描述: Sensor triggered too frequently.
原因: The material is fed too fast, resulting in a sensor triggering cycle of less than 0.6s, which can lead to excessively high photography frequency.
应对措施: Reduce the trigger frequency of sensor.

描述: DO电平保持时间过长
原因: 存在 DO电平保持时间 大于 传感器触发周期的情况，则会导致传感器触发拍照不及时
应对措施: 减小参数“IO电平保持时间”的值，或者减小传感器触发的频率

描述: The holding time of DO level is too long
原因: The holding time of the DO level is less than the trigger cycle of sensor, which will cause that the sensor does not trigger to take pictures in time
应对措施: Reduce the value of the parameter " holding time of IO level ", or reduce the trigger frequency of sensor

描述: 视觉数据发送次数过多

应对措施: 查看是否视觉数据多发，或者发生了不正常的视觉拍照，以及参数【相机触发信号】是否选择有误

描述: Vision data sent too many times.
原因: After the robot triggers a photo, it receives vision data more than once before the next photo is taken.
应对措施: Check whether the visual data is sent multiple times or whether the photographing is abnormal, and whether the camera trigger signal is selected correctly.

You can add delay such as waiting and logical interaction in actual application to the test program and test again.

原因: The joint limit position is reached.
应对措施: Perform negative motion to clear the alarm.

描述: 轴3负限位报警
原因: 到达关节极限位置
应对措施: 正向运动清除

描述: J3 axis negative limit alarm
原因: The joint limit position is reached.
应对措施: Perform positive motion to clear the alarm.

描述: 轴3驱动报警
原因: 驱动器出现报警
应对措施: 根据报警码查阅伺服手册做相应的故障排除

描述: J3 axis drive alarm
原因: The drive has an alarm.
应对措施: Perform troubleshooting by referring to the servo manual according to fault codes.

描述: 轴3规划溢出报警
应对措施: 检查绝对原点位置是否选择在靠近计数极限边沿位置，若是，则在原点位置时，将驱动器位置清圈数

描述: J3 axis path planning out of range
原因: The planned value exceeds the maximum calculation range (-1073741823 to 1073741824).
应对措施: Check whether the absolute origin position is selected to be near the counting limit edge. If the zero point is near the boundary, clear the driver turns.

描述: 轴3跟随误差过大报警
原因: 规划位置和实际位置差过大
应对措施: (1)查看跟随误差阈值(2)检查机械是否有卡滞(3)检查动力线缆连接是否正常(4)检查负载于伺服增益是否匹配(5)查询跟随误差排障手册

描述: Excessive tracking error of J3 axis
原因: The difference between the planned and actual positions is too large.
应对措施: 1. View the tracking error threshold. 2. Check for mechanical stuck. 3. Check that the power lines are properly connected. 4. Check that the load matches the servo gain. 5. Consult the troubleshooting guide.

描述: 轴3速度过大报警
原因: 运行速度大于设定的最大速度
应对措施: 降低第3关节速度

描述: J3 axis overspeed
原因: The running speed is greater than the set maximum speed.
应对措施: Reduce the speed of J3 axis.

描述: 轴3的驱动强电未上
原因: 强电未上
应对措施: 检查驱动器电路，是否强电未上

描述: Strong current of J3 axis is not switched on.
原因: Strong current is not switched on.
应对措施: Check the drive circuit for whether strong current is not switched on.

描述: 第3关节转矩超限
原因: 关节转矩超出允许值
应对措施: (1)适当减小加速度参数；(2)检测负载参数设置是否合适，将其适当改大；(3)如果开启最优轨迹，参考最优轨迹的调制指导，

描述: J3 axis torque overlimit
原因: The actual maximum current exceeds the limit.
应对措施: 1. Reduce the acceleration parameters appropriately. 2. Check that the load parameter settings are appropriate. 3. If the optimal trajectory is enabled, refer to the modulation guidance of the optimal trajectory.

描述: 第3关节平均负载率超限
原因: 平均负载率超出温升、寿命的限制；
应对措施: (1)排查抱闸问题、机械卡死、驱动器问题;(2)适当降低速度或加速度百分比；(3)延长非运动时间；纯运动节拍测试时可能会出现平均负载率超限，此时不代表实际应用时超限，可将实际应用中的等待、逻辑交互等延时加入测试程序再测试；

描述: J3 axis average load rate overlimit
原因: The average load rate exceeds the limits of temperature rise and lifespan.
应对措施: 1. Investigate brake, mechanical jamming, and drive. 2. Reduce the speed or acceleration percentage appropriately. 3. Extend the non-motion time. In the pure motion beat test, the average load rate may exceed the limit, which does not mean that it exceeds the limit in actual application. You can add delay such as waiting and logical interaction in actual application to the test program and test again.

描述: 第3关节速度超出设定值
原因: 对规划输出进行校验时发现超出了设定的关节速度
应对措施: (1)如果是CP运动，适当降低位置速度或增大关节速度，或调整点位远离奇异区(2)查看报警记录是否有其他伴随报警

描述: J3 axis speed overlimit
原因: When verifying the planned output, it was found that the set joint acceleration was exceeded.
应对措施: 1. In case of CP motion, reduce position speed or increase joint speed appropriately, or adjust the points to move away from singularities. 2. Check if there are any other accompanying alarms in the alarm record.

描述: 第3关节加速度超出设定值
原因: 对规划输出进行校验时发现超出了设定的关节加速度
应对措施: (1)如果是CP运动，适当降低位置速度或增大关节速度，或调整点位远离奇异区(2)查看报警记录是否有其他伴随报警

描述: J3 axis acceleration overlimit
原因: When verifying the planned output, it was found that the set joint acceleration was exceeded.
应对措施: 1. In case of CP motion, reduce position speed or increase joint speed appropriately, or adjust the points to move away from singularities. 2. Check if there are any other accompanying alarms in the alarm record.

描述: 第3关节使能同步异常
原因: 上使前机器人有振动或上使能过程中因外部原因对机器人造成运动
应对措施: 检查上电时刻是否关节有运动，检查上使能过程中是否有外力因素干扰

描述: J3 axis enable synchronization error
原因: The robot vibrates before it is enabled, or the robot moves due to external reasons during the enabling process.
应对措施: Check whether there is joint movement during power on, and whether there is external interference during the enabling process.

描述: 第3关节到位超时
原因: 伺服到位时间过长
应对措施: 检查到位误差是否过小或者伺服增益不合适

描述: J3 axis arrival timeout
原因: The servo takes too long to arrive the target position.
应对措施: Check whether the arrival error threshold is too small or whether the servo gain is not proper.

描述: 关节3位置反馈异常
原因: (1)圈值发生变化(2)码器位置跳变
应对措施: 检查是否人为清除，若不是，请检查干扰源

描述: J3 axis position feedback error
原因: 1.? Multi-turn value changes. 2.? Encoder position jumps.
应对措施: Check if the multi turn value has been manually cleared. If not, check for the interference source.

描述: 第3关节下使能状态异常
原因: 机器人未能在规定的时间与距离内下使能
应对措施: 1、检查伺服参数6084参数，抱闸设置，0209是否正确2、查看负载是否超规格使用

描述: J3 axis disable status error
原因: The robot failed to be disabled at the specified time and distance.
应对措施: 1. Check that servo parameter 6084 and brake parameter 0209 are correctly set. 2. Check if the load exceeds the limit.

应对措施: 请往反向运动，报警会自动清除

描述: J4 axis negative limit alarm
原因: The joint limit position is reached.
应对措施: Perform negative motion to clear the alarm.

描述: 轴4驱动报警
原因: 驱动器出现报警
应对措施: 根据报警码查阅伺服手册做相应的故障排除

描述: J4 axis drive alarm
原因: The drive has an alarm.
应对措施: Perform troubleshooting by referring to the servo manual according to fault codes.

描述: 轴4规划溢出报警
应对措施: 检查绝对原点位置是否选择在靠近计数极限边沿位置，若是，则在原点位置时，将驱动器位置清圈数

描述: J4 axis path planning out of range
原因: The planned value exceeds the maximum calculation range (-1073741823 to 1073741824).
应对措施: Check whether the absolute origin position is selected to be near the counting limit. If the zero point is near the limit, clear the drive turns.

描述: 轴4跟随误差过大报警
原因: 规划位置和实际位置差过大
应对措施: (1)查看跟随误差阈值(2)检查机械是否有卡滞(3)检查动力线缆连接是否正常(4)检查负载于伺服增益是否匹配(5)查询跟随误差排障手册

描述: Excessive tracking error of J4 axis
原因: The difference between the planned and actual positions is too large.
应对措施: 1. View the tracking error threshold. 2. Check for mechanical stuck. 3. Check that the power lines are properly connected. 4. Check that the load matches the servo gain. 5. Consult the troubleshooting guide.

描述: 轴4速度过大报警
原因: 运行速度大于设定的最大速度
应对措施: 降低第4关节速度

描述: J4 axis overspeed
原因: The running speed is greater than the set maximum speed.
应对措施: Reduce the speed of J4 axis.

描述: 轴4的驱动强电未上
原因: 强电未上
应对措施: 检查驱动器电路，是否强电未上

描述: Strong current of J4 axis is not switched on.
原因: Strong current is not switched on.
应对措施: Check the drive circuit for whether strong current is not switched on.

描述: 第4关节转矩超限
原因: 关节转矩超出允许值
应对措施: (1)适当减小加速度参数；(2)检测负载参数设置是否合适，将其适当改大；(3)如果开启最优轨迹，参考最优轨迹的调制指导，

描述: J4 axis torque overlimit
原因: The actual maximum current exceeds the limit.
应对措施: 1. Reduce the acceleration parameters appropriately. 2. Check that the load parameter settings are appropriate. 3. If the optimal trajectory is enabled, refer to the modulation guidance of the optimal trajectory.

描述: 第4关节平均负载率超限
原因: 平均负载率超出温升、寿命的限制；
应对措施: (1)排查抱闸问题、机械卡死、驱动器问题;(2)适当降低速度或加速度百分比；(3)延长非运动时间；纯运动节拍测试时可能会出现平均负载率超限，此时不代表实际应用时超限，可将实际应用中的等待、逻辑交互等延时加入测试程序再测试；

描述: J4 axis average load rate overlimit
原因: The average load rate exceeds the limits of temperature rise and lifespan.
应对措施: 1. Investigate brake, mechanical jamming, and drive. 2. Reduce the speed or acceleration percentage appropriately. 3. Extend the non-motion time. In the pure motion beat test, the average load rate may exceed the limit, which does not mean that it exceeds the limit in actual application. You can add delay such as waiting and logical interaction in actual application to the test program and test again.

描述: 第4关节速度超出设定值
原因: 对规划输出进行校验时发现超出了设定的关节速度
应对措施: (1)如果是CP运动，适当降低位置速度或增大关节速度，或调整点位远离奇异区(2)查看报警记录是否有其他伴随报警

描述: J4 axis speed overlimit
原因: When verifying the planned output, it was found that the set joint acceleration was exceeded.
应对措施: 1. In case of CP motion, reduce position speed or increase joint speed appropriately, or adjust the points to move away from singularities. 2. Check if there are any other accompanying alarms in the alarm record.

描述: 第4关节加速度超出设定值
原因: 对规划输出进行校验时发现超出了设定的关节加速度
应对措施: (1)如果是CP运动，适当降低位置速度或增大关节速度，或调整点位远离奇异区(2)查看报警记录是否有其他伴随报警

描述: J4 axis acceleration overlimit
原因: When verifying the planned output, it was found that the set joint acceleration was exceeded.
应对措施: 1. In case of CP motion, reduce position speed or increase joint speed appropriately, or adjust the points to move away from singularities. 2. Check if there are any other accompanying alarms in the alarm record.

描述: 第4关节使能同步异常
原因: 上使前机器人有振动或上使能过程中因外部原因对机器人造成运动
应对措施: 检查上电时刻是否关节有运动，检查上使能过程中是否有外力因素干扰

描述: J4 axis enable synchronization error
原因: The robot vibrates before it is enabled, or the robot moves due to external reasons during the enabling process.
应对措施: Check whether there is joint movement during power on, and whether there is external interference during the enabling process.

描述: 第4关节到位超时
原因: 伺服到位时间过长
应对措施: 检查到位误差是否过小或者伺服增益不合适

描述: J4 axis arrival timeout
原因: The servo takes too long to arrive the target position.
应对措施: Check whether the arrival error threshold is too small or whether the servo gain is not proper.

描述: 关节4位置反馈异常
原因: (1)圈值发生变化(2)码器位置跳变
应对措施: 检查是否人为清除，若不是，请检查干扰源

描述: J4 axis position feedback error
原因: 1.? Multi-turn value changes. 2.? Encoder position jumps.
应对措施: Check if the multi turn value has been manually cleared. If not, check for the interference source.

描述: 第4关节下使能状态异常
原因: 机器人未能在规定的时间与距离内下使能
应对措施: 1、检查伺服参数6084参数，抱闸设置，0209是否正确2、查看负载是否超规格使用

描述: J4 axis disable status error
原因: The robot failed to be disabled at the specified time and distance.
应对措施: 1. Check that servo parameter 6084 and brake parameter 0209 are correctly set. 2. Check if the load exceeds the limit.

描述: 检测到J1轴异常，且机器人和基座都在运动的过程中，判断第1关节发生随动碰撞，请确认外部轴是否运动并检查是否发生碰撞；如无碰撞，请确认该轴电机是否发生故障，排查外部线缆干涉、拉扯的情况；如无异常，确认负载参数设置是否正确、确认碰撞检测参数是否已调试；若仍无异常请参考说明书排查原因或调试碰撞检测参数。

应对措施: 请确认外部轴是否运动并检查是否发生碰撞，若未发生碰撞，请：1）检查负载参数是否设置正确；2）检查控制器中的机器人型号是否与本体一致；3）检查机器人是否出现电机卡死、抱闸未打开等情况；4）若存在机器人长时间冷机后突然启动的情况，请适当热机后再运行；若存在长时间运行后机器人摩擦力显著降低的情况，须联系厂商重新辨识摩擦力；5）若工作在高速重载等工况下，导致电流出现了饱和现象，此时也很容易发生误报警，这种工况已经超出机器人的负载能力，需要避免工作在这种条件下；也可尝试通过指令进入中等精度模式或手动打开所有轴的速度前馈在一定程度上解决该问题。6）若确定为误报，可适当调大该轴的碰撞检测灵敏度，建议使用碰撞检测灵敏度推荐值；7）若仍无效，可尝试关闭该轴的碰撞检测开关.

描述: Upon detecting an anomaly in J1? while both the robot and its base are in motion, indicating that J1 is experiencing follow-up collision, please verify if the external axis are moving and check for any collisions. If no collision is detected, confirm whether there is a malfunction with the motor of this axis,check for any external cable interference or pulling issues. Assuming everything seems normal without any issues, ensure that the load parameters are correctly set and that the collision detection parameters have been properly tuned. Should you still not encounter any anomalies, please refer to the user manual for troubleshooting steps or adjust the collision detection parameters accordingly.

If no collision is detected, confirm whether there is a malfunction with the motor of this axis. Assuming everything seems normal without any issues, ensure that the load parameters are correctly set and that the collision detection parameters have been properly tuned. Should you still not encounter any anomalies, please refer to the user manual for troubleshooting steps or adjust the collision detection parameters accordingly,and confirm whether it is due to the limited servo tracking ability.If there is no abnormality, confirm whether the robot has a long period of cold machine or a long period of operation after a significant change in friction; if there is still no abnormality, please refer to the manual to troubleshoot the cause or debug the collision detection parameters.

Should you still not encounter any anomalies, please refer to the user manual for troubleshooting steps or adjust the collision detection parameters accordingly.

描述: J5 axis negative limit alarm
原因: The joint limit position is reached.
应对措施: Perform positive motion to clear the alarm.

描述: 轴5驱动报警
原因: 驱动器出现报警
应对措施: 根据报警码查阅伺服手册做相应的故障排除

描述: J5 axis drive alarm
原因: The drive has an alarm.
应对措施: Perform troubleshooting by referring to the servo manual according to fault codes.

描述: 轴5规划溢出报警
应对措施: 检查绝对原点位置是否选择在靠近计数极限边沿位置，若是，则在原点位置时，将驱动器位置清圈数

描述: J5 axis path planning out of range
原因: The planned value exceeds the maximum calculation range (-1073741823 to 1073741824).
应对措施: Check whether the absolute origin position is selected to be near the counting limit. If the zero point is near the limit, clear the drive turns.

描述: 轴5跟随误差过大报警
原因: 规划位置和实际位置差过大
应对措施: (1)查看跟随误差阈值(2)检查机械是否有卡滞(3)检查动力线缆连接是否正常(4)检查负载于伺服增益是否匹配(5)查询跟随误差排障手册

描述: Excessive tracking error of J5 axis
原因: The difference between the planned and actual positions is too large.
应对措施: 1. View the tracking error threshold. 2. Check for mechanical stuck. 3. Check that the power lines are properly connected. 4. Check that the load matches the servo gain. 5. Consult the troubleshooting guide.

描述: 轴5速度过大报警
原因: 运行速度大于设定的最大速度
应对措施: 降低第5关节速度

描述: J5 axis overspeed
原因: The running speed is greater than the set maximum speed.
应对措施: Reduce the speed of J5 axis.

描述: 轴5的驱动强电未上
原因: 强电未上
应对措施: 检查驱动器电路，是否强电未上

描述: Strong current of J5 axis is not switched on.
原因: Strong current is not switched on.

原因: Upon detecting an anomaly in J1? while both the robot and its base are in motion, indicating that J1 is experiencing follow-up collision, please verify if the external axis are moving and check for any collisions. If no collision is detected, confirm whether there is a malfunction with the motor of this axis. Assuming everything seems normal without any issues, ensure that the load parameters are correctly set and that the collision detection parameters have been properly tuned. Should you still not encounter any anomalies, please refer to the user manual for troubleshooting steps or adjust the collision detection parameters accordingly,and confirm whether it is due to the limited servo tracking ability.If there is no abnormality, confirm whether the robot has a long period of cold machine or a long period of operation after a significant change in friction; if there is still no abnormality, please refer to the manual to troubleshoot the cause or debug the collision detection parameters.

(6) If it is determined to be a false alarm, you can appropriately adjust the axis of the collision detection sensitivity, it is recommended to use the recommended value of the collision detection sensitivity; (7) If it is still not effective, you can try to turn off the axis of the collision detection switch.

描述: EtherCAT(现场总线)与主站连接断开

描述: EtherCAT disconnected from master.
原因: Loose EtherCAT cable connection, EtherCAT master failure, or robot system failure.
应对措施: Check whether the network cable is plugged in properly or has poor contact, check the EtherCAT master, or contact the manufacturer.

描述: ModbusTCP连接因网络超时断开
原因: ModbusTCP连接的网络通讯不通
应对措施: 检查网线是否插好或者接触不良

描述: ModbusTCP was disconnected since network timeout
原因: Network communication on ModbusTCP connection does not work.
应对措施: Check whether the network cable is plugged in properly or has poor contact.

描述: Profinet扩展卡设备缺失
原因: 已激活的PN扩展卡与控制柜通信断开
应对措施: 请按如下顺序检查确认：1.检查PN扩展卡与卡槽是否连接牢固;2.检查PN扩展卡前面板NS指示灯是否为绿色常亮或绿色闪烁;3.检查控制柜重新上电后该PN扩展卡是否可被激活;

描述: Profinet expansion card missing.
原因: The activated Profinet expansion card has lost communication with the controller.
应对措施: 1. Check that the PN expansion card is securely connected to the card slot. 2. Check that the NS indicator light on the front panel of the PN expansion card is solid green or flashing green. 3. Check that the PN expansion card can be activated after the controller is powered on again.

描述: EtherCAT(现场总线)通讯同步失败
原因: 由于硬件原因导致同步信号不产生
应对措施: 联系厂家返厂维修

描述: EtherCAT (fieldbus) communication synchronization failed.
原因: The synchronization signal is not generated due to hardware errors.
应对措施: Contact the manufacturer.

描述: EtherCAT(现场总线)通讯IRQ丢失超限
原因: 1、数据帧在前端站点已经丢失，或者被丢弃2、主站的性能较差，IRQ的抖动超过设置值（H0E-22）* 通讯周期的值
应对措施: 1、检查主站CPU运行负载2、降低通讯时间3、检查前面站点是否存在link丢失

描述: EtherCAT(Fieldbus) IQR Over Lose
原因: 1. The data frame has been lost or discarded at an upstream station. 2. The performance of the host station is poor, the jitter of the IRQ exceeds the set value (H0E-22) * communication cycle.
应对措施: 1. Check the CPU usage of the master. 2. Reduce the communication time. 3. Check whether link loss occurs on the upstream slave.

描述: EtherCAT(现场总线) EEPROM 加载出错
原因: 程序启动过程中，EEPROM中前8个字节数据错误，导致EtherCAT从站启动失败
应对措施: 联系厂家处理（重新烧录XML文件）

描述: EtherCAT(Fieldbus) EEPROM Load Error
原因: During program start-up, the first 8 bytes of data in the EEPROM were wrong, causing EtherCAT slave to fail to start.
应对措施: Contact the manufacturer to re-burn the XML file.

描述: EtherCAT(现场总线) 初始化错误
原因: EtherCAT(现场总线) 初始化错误
应对措施: 硬件故障，请联系厂家处理

描述: EtherCAT(Fieldbus) Initial Error
原因: EtherCAT (fieldbus) initialization error.
应对措施: Hardware failure, please contact the manufacturer.

描述: EtherCAT(现场总线）状态切换错误
原因: 由于主站的误操作，或者人为的误操作导致状态切换错误
应对措施: 联系厂家处理

描述: EtherCAT(Fieldbus) State Switch Error
原因: Bad state switching due to incorrect operation of the master or human error.
应对措施: Contact the manufacturer.

描述: EtherCAT(现场总线)从站未使能DC错误
原因: 在DC模式中，没有同步信号导致运动不正常，原因是：主站故障或主站操作不当
应对措施: 联系厂家处理

描述: DC not enabled for EtherCAT slave.
原因: In DC mode, there is no synchronization signal causing abnormal movement due to master fault or improper master operation.
应对措施: Contact the manufacturer.

描述: EtherCAT(现场总线)PDO配置个数超限
原因: EtherCAT(现场总线)PDO配置个数超限
应对措施: 检查主站的PDO配置个数是否超限

描述: EtherCAT (fieldbus) PDO overlimit.
原因: EtherCAT (fieldbus) PDO overlimit.
应对措施: Check whether the number of PDOs configured for the master exceeds the limit.

描述: EtherCAT(现场总线)Link丢失
原因: 由于数据链路的物理连接不稳定，或者拨插网线导致的过程数据丢失
应对措施: 检查网线连接是否可靠、牢固、现场是否震动激烈

描述: EtherCAT (fieldbus) link missing.
原因: The physical connection of the data link is unstable or the process data is lost due to plug-in/plug-out of the network cable.
应对措施: Check whether the network cable is connected properly and whether the application site suffers from strong vibration.

描述: EtherCAT(现场总线)连接存在链路干扰
原因: 由于EMC干扰，或者网线质量不良，连接不良导致的数据丢失
应对措施: 检测是否可靠接地，整改EMC，检查网线是否为汇川指定网线，检查网线连接是否可靠

描述: EtherCAT (fieldbus) link interfered.
原因: The data is lost due to EMC interference, poor quality of the network cable or improper connection.
应对措施: Check whether proper grounding is performed and rectify EMC measures. Check whether the network cable used is provided by Inovance and whether the network cable is properly connected.

描述: EtherCAT(现场总线)转发错误
原因: 由于前端站点就已经检测出数据帧被破坏，导致数据无效
应对措施: 检查前端站点，具体问题需要通过前端站点定位

描述: EtherCAT (fieldbus) data forward error.
原因: The upstream station detects that the data frame has been corrupted, leading to a data transfer error.
应对措施: Check the upstream station to locate the fault cause.

描述: EtherCAT(现场总线)未接收到数据

应对措施: 1. Check whether the vision trigger signal is delivered successfully. 2. If the vision trigger signal is delivered successfully every time, check whether the camera will take pictures normally every time. 3. The processing time of vision software is too long, or the delay time of data transmission is too long.

描述: Points with too small spacing in curve.
原因: Repetitive or small spacing of input points on the curve results in the inability to construct the curve.
应对措施: Remove duplicate or too close points.

描述: 欧拉退化导致的姿态变化过大

应对措施: 避开退化位置，或者手动调整AC值，避免曲线点位姿态间距过大

描述: Excessive orientation change caused by Euler degradation.
原因: When the absolute value of Euler angle B approaches 90 °, the AC angle configuration fluctuates too much, resulting in excessive spacing.
应对措施: Avoid degraded positions or manually adjust AC values to avoid excessive spacing between curve positions and orientations.

描述: 曲线路径点关节运动量过大
